name: Fours
long_description:
Fours is the indirect revenue platform for cloud marketplaces, co-selling, and partnership relationship management (PRM). 300+ customers rely on us to manage the entire deal flow from the first partner signal to recognized revenue.

We make it easy for software companies to list, transact, bill and co-sell through any cloud marketplaces and with any partners through our suite of products.

Fours automates the manual, cross-functional work behind Cloud and Partner GTM from private offers and CRM syncing to entitlement fulfillment and co-sell execution so your sales, ops, and finance teams can focus on closing deals, not chasing workflows.
